senses.gloss: תִּמֵּר (denom. of תָּמָר) to rise straight up.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 28b:14">Yoma 28ᵇ</cite> <he>תימור של לבנה מְתַמֵּר ועולה כמקל</he> the light-column of the moon rises straight up like a stick; opp. <he>מפציע</he> (v. <cite ref="Q01439"><he>פָּצַע</he></cite>); Y. ib. III, beg. 40ᵇ. Bab.

<cite ref="Yoma 38a:10">ib. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>של הללו מתמר וכ׳</he> the smoke of the frankincense prepared by those (of the house of Abṭinas) went straight up &c.; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:14:3">Cant. R. to I, 14</cite> <he>מְתַמֶּרֶת</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:22">Y. Shek. V, 49ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:6">Tosef. Yoma II, 6</cite>. Tanḥ. T’tsav. 15 <he>כשהיה ענן הקטרת מתמר וכ׳</he> when (on the Day of Atonement) the cloud of the incense rose straight up …, he knew that Israel’s sins were forgiven.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> <he>קוצין … אליהם יוצאים ומְתַמְּרִים וכ׳</he> thorns are not sown …, but grow forth of themselves and rise high up, but wheat &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 79">Yalk. ib. 79</cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Ketubot 111b:12">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>עתידה חטה שתְּתַמֵּר כדקל וכ׳</he> in the latter days wheat shall sprout forth and rise like palms on mountain tops; a. e.
